title: Find Prime Factorisation of a Number using Sieve
intro: Primality: trial division to √n is the baseline; sieve appears when you need many queries.

complexity.time: O(√n) trial / O(n log log n) sieve build

pitfalls: Checking up to n instead of √n.

python.code:
def is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
    if n < 2: return False
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0: return False
        i += 1
    return True
